curatedMovie.curiosityHook: How will Max Manus’s life as a resistance fighter unfold from the Winter War to Norway’s peacetime in 1945?
curatedMovie.description: After serving in the Winter War, Norwegian fighter Max Manus returns home just as World War II overtakes Norway, throwing himself into an escalating underground resistance campaign.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Tense, grounded historical war drama. Deliberate yet suspenseful, carrying real emotional gravity best suited for focused viewing.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Directed by Espen Sandberg and Joachim Rønning, this historical war drama balances tactical underground suspense with the heavy human toll of sustained resistance.
